observations: Photo 0 shows two separate headlamp assemblies (front lights) laid on a tiled floor; each has a clear lens and visible mounting brackets/holders.
Photo 0 headlamp lenses look intact from this angle (no obvious cracks), but there is no close-up of the lens surface or reflector condition.
Photo 1 shows a front grille with a central badge/emblem; the grille is chrome/black with vertical slats.
Photo 1 does not show any tail light (rear lamp).

claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and tailight in working condition available in GRA Ikeja.
claims.evidence: Photos show a front grille (photo 1) and headlamp assemblies (photo 0), but no tail light is shown, and 'working condition' cannot be verified from photos.
Photo 1 clearly shows a front grille assembly.
No tail light/rear lamp is visible in either photo; photo 0 shows headlamps.
No photo/video of the lights being powered/illuminated; no test results shown.
Location is stated in text only; photos do not confirm it.

risks.risk: Tail light may not be included (seller text says tailight, but photos show headlamps and a grille).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact tail light (rear lamp) showing the full unit and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as grille + headlamp assemblies only (tail light treated as not included).

risks.risk: “Working condition” not verifiable—bulbs/LEDs/reflector housings may be faulty or missing.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video powering the lights (show both units lit) or a test with a connector/12V supply.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case: bulbs/LEDs not functioning).

risks.risk: Wrong side/fitment or wrong Prado variant (different years/trim can change lamp/grille shape and connectors).
risks.proof: Ask for the part number/label (if any) and a photo of the connector side + mounting tabs alignment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/fitment uncertain (worst case: may require adjustment/extra parts).

risks.risk: Lens/reflector damage not obvious from the current angles (scratches, haze, internal moisture).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of lens surface (front and edges) and reflector inside, plus a photo showing no condensation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically used/unknown condition (worst case: needs polishing or has haze).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the tail light (rear lamp) if it truly exists, showing the full unit and mounting points.
Send a short video showing the headlamp(s) and/or tail light being powered and illuminated (both sides).
Send close-up photos of lens condition (front + edges) and reflector/inside condition.
Send connector-side photos and any part number/label for fitment verification.
response.reason: The photos confirm a front grille and headlamp assemblies, but the seller claims a tail light and 'working condition'—neither is verifiable from the provided images. Proof is needed to avoid paying for the wrong parts or non-working units.
